prompt: The client wants to acquire a target that is both growing fast and profitable. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Company C has the largest revenue
options.feedback: True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.
That misreads the chart: A grows 5%; B grows 25%.

options.text: Only Company B is both growing fast and profitable
options.feedback: Right. B grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; A grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.

options.text: Company B has the strongest management team
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: Only Company B is both growing fast and profitable. B grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; A grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.

extras.proof: B grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; A grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.
